content:
I've been trying to submit something to Palomar and AI review flagged something, and I fixed it, and then at the second try it flagged something again which was just wrong.

AI review being wrong is not the problem, the problem here is that the wrong AI review is blocking, so I get "Registration is not offered" just because of the wrong AI review and there is no way to appeal the review.

cc @Kim Morrison

the specific wrong AI slop is that because I wrote n / t instead of (n / t : \R) then AI thought i'm using truncated natural division; again this doesn't matter because the real problem is the fact that AI review is blocking
Can you just submit it over again? I went through something like 7 rounds of resubmissions before my project went through.
(Submit it again with the explicit type annotation added, I mean)
